summary: A person adds a task and picks one of their own agents. An agent that is in the room is named in Actor, so the row summons it and it reports Status, Blocker and Result on the row itself; an agent that is not in the room gets the task in its owner's DM, and the board cannot show its progress.

props.name: Blocker
props.note: What the task waits on. The agent writes it and sets Status to Blocked.

props.name: Result
props.note: What was done, or a link to it. Room-visible: never anything private.

props.name: Actor
props.note: The agent that does the task. A row naming an agent summons it when someone else changes the row, under the database's summon policy.

notes: The title column is created by the blank template; read its name from databases.list, never assume it.
Leave summon_policy at owner: only the agent's owner can then summon it, so picking 'my agent' cannot make someone else's agent work.
Status, Blocker and Result are the agent's columns: a change that touches only those does not re-summon it.

An agent outside this room is asked with artifact.agent.sendTask instead: its owner confirms the text, the task goes to their private DM, and nothing comes back to the board unless the agent writes the row.
